title: Object Count Generalization Is an Interface Problem: Warping a Frozen Skill Instead of Retraining It
abstract: arXiv:2611.30765v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning policies for robot manipulation degrade when the number of objects N in the scene grows beyond the training range. This is a covariate shift that also changes the dimension of the state. We propose WAVE (Warping Actions and Views of an Expert), which extends a pretrained single-object skill to many objects without updating its weights. WAVE has three parts. First, a selection policy picks the one object the robot works on next. Second, a warping policy reads a local view of the scene around that object, whose size does not depend on N. It emits a multiplier and an offset for every quantity the skill reads and every action it outputs. Third, the skill acts under this affine warp. It is shown a scene that holds a single object, while the warp steers it around the objects it is not shown and edits the actions that are sent to the robot. Both the selection and warping policies are trained with PPO on the multi-object

translated_title: 物体数量泛化是一个接口问题：对冻结技能进行扭曲变形而非重新训练
translated_abstract: 用于机器人操作的强化学习策略在场景中物体数量N超出训练范围时会性能退化。这是一种协变量偏移，同时也改变了状态的维度。我们提出WAVE（Warping Actions and Views of an Expert，对专家的动作与视图进行扭曲），它无需更新权重即可将预训练的单物体技能扩展到多物体场景。WAVE包含三个部分。首先，一个选择策略挑选机器人下一个要操作的物体。其次，一个扭曲策略读取该物体周围场景的局部视图，其大小不依赖于N。它为技能读取的每一个量以及输出的每一个动作生成一个乘数和一个偏移量。第三，技能在这个仿射扭曲下执行动作。结果表明，场景中只需容纳一个物体，扭曲机制会引导它在未被展示的其他物体之间穿梭，并编辑发送给机器人的动作。选择策略和扭曲策略均在多物体环境中使用PPO进行训练。
tldr: 该论文提出WAVE方法，通过一个选择策略和一个扭曲策略对冻结的预训练单物体技能的输入输出进行仿射变换（乘数与偏移），在不更新任何权重的情况下，使机器人操作技能能够泛化到物体数量超出训练范围的场景。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes WAVE, which extends a frozen pretrained single-object manipulation skill to scenes with arbitrarily many objects by using a selection policy and a warping policy that affinely warps the skill's inputs and outputs—without retraining any weights.
